assessment: This valuable work will be of interest to scientists who study cardiomyocyte homeostasis and contraction. Using solid methodology, this study is the first to assess the consequences of cardiomyocyte-specific knockout of Palladin, identifying a compensation mechanism that takes place when this gene is deleted in embryogenesis, but not in adulthood. In addition, this study identifies novel Palladin interactors, suggests a role for Palladin in the maintenance of intercalated disc structure, and assesses levels of Palladin expression in human samples.
